_README: Maps each synthesised data group in published_benchmarks.json to its public source(s). This study transcribes and aggregates these published figures; it does not measure them.

references.herbst_2013: Herbst, N. R., Kounev, S., & Reussner, R. (2013). Elasticity in Cloud Computing: What It Is, and What It Is Not. Proc. 10th Int'l Conf. on Autonomic Computing (ICAC '13), USENIX, 23-27.
references.lehrig_2015: Lehrig, S., Eikerling, H., & Becker, S. (2015). Scalability, Elasticity, and Efficiency in Cloud Computing: A Systematic Literature Review of Definitions and Metrics. QoSA '15, ACM, 83-92.
references.stonebraker_1986: Stonebraker, M. (1986). The Case for Shared Nothing. IEEE Database Engineering Bulletin, 9(1), 4-9.
references.duan_2025_pipeco: Duan, J., Qian, S., Hu, H., Yang, D., Cao, J., & Xue, G. (2025). PipeCo: Pipelining Cold Start of Deep Learning Inference Services on Serverless Platforms. Proc. ACM on Measurement and Analysis of Computing Systems, 9(2), 1-23.
references.ycsb_workload_a: Cooper, B. F., Silberstein, A., Tam, E., Ramakrishnan, R., & Sears, R. (2010). Benchmarking cloud serving systems with YCSB. ACM SoCC. (Workload A profile basis for Table 1.)
references.cockroach_cloud_report: Cockroach Labs. Cloud Report (latest editions within study window). Used for cross-provider latency/throughput context.
references.spec_cloud: Standard Performance Evaluation Corporation. SPEC Cloud IaaS benchmark results (study window).
references.principled_technologies_cosmos: Principled Technologies / Microsoft. Azure Cosmos DB vs DynamoDB NoSQL performance (vendor-commissioned; ~1M ops/s condition). Used ONLY for the explicitly condition-flagged 3.15 ms figure.
references.provider_pue_disclosures_2024: Provider 2024 sustainability disclosures (Google Cloud data-centre efficiency reporting; AWS sustainability reporting; Microsoft Azure sustainability reporting).
references.wimadev_serverless_pricing_2025: Wimadev. Comparing Prices: AWS Fargate vs Azure Container Apps vs Google Cloud Run (US-East, x86 Linux, monthly standard compute), 2025. Basis for list price per vCPU/GB.
references.sliplane_serverless_pricing_2025: Sliplane. Comparing Prices: AWS Fargate vs Azure Container Apps vs Google Cloud Run, 2025. Billing-model and egress comparison.
references.cloudexmachina_fargate_pricing_2025: Cloud ex Machina. AWS Fargate Pricing Explained (per-second vCPU/memory billing, 1-minute minimum), 2025.
references.byteiota_arm_x86_2025: byteiota. ARM vs x86 Cloud: 2025 Performance & Cost Benchmark. Graviton4 ~42% better price-performance (9% faster at 33% lower cost) vs comparable x86.
references.hykell_graviton_pricing_2026: Hykell. AWS ARM vs x86 pricing: Is Graviton really cheaper for your workload? ARM ~20% lower hourly, up to ~40% better price-performance.
references.aws_graviton_official: Amazon Web Services. AWS Graviton (EC2) official page: Graviton-based instances up to 20% lower cost and up to 60% less energy than comparable x86.
